Startup apps, services and app details
Private by design — no internet permission
SysMon uses Android\'s Usage access permission to show your screen time per app, and per-app network and storage usage, on the Processes and App history screens.
SysMon has no internet permission — this data never leaves your device.
Granting is optional, and you can revoke it at any time in system settings.
Usage access is on — screen time and per-app data are available.
You can grant usage access anytime from Settings.
